subject: Request: IRP, access logs and SOC 2 evidence for Sep 2 access anomaly
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@finoptics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Unusual access event on Sep 2 — request for IRP and supporting evidence

Hi team,

We detected an unusual access pattern against our shared staging workspace on Sep 2 (approx 05:30 UTC). No customer data appears to have been exfiltrated, but our security & compliance team needs a handful of documents to close the incident ticket on our side:

- Current Incident Response Plan for external reporting (SOC 2 alignment)
- Access logs and session IDs for Sep 2 (UTC window 05:00–06:00)
- Any internal postmortem or initial findings you can share

Can you confirm whether you can share an IRP PDF and the raw access log slice as CSV? We need this for our SIG intake and auditors.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivera
Security Operations
FinOptics

(Attachment: none)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@finoptics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual access event on Sep 2 — request for IRP and supporting evidence

Alex — thanks for flagging this. We'll compile the requested artifacts and set up a short walkthrough. Preliminary notes: the staging access was an automated job that retried several times after a token refresh. No PII keys were included in the logs we reviewed.

Action plan (we'll do this by EOD Mon unless you need faster):
- Priyom: package IRP and authoritative incident checklist (PDF)
- Monica: export access logs for 2026-09-02 05:00–06:00 UTC and filter session IDs
- Ben: prepare a 30-min walkthrough recording + live call if needed

I'll attach the IRP draft and the initial CSV slice in the next email. If FinOptics needs signed evidence (S3/immutable logs), let me know and we can add the hash stamps.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: none)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@finoptics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual access event on Sep 2 — access logs extract attached

Priyom / Alex — attaching the filtered CSV for the window you requested. Notes:
- Rows include timestamp (UTC), user_id, session_id, source_ip, request_path, response_code
- We redacted token-like values and replaced them with <REDACTED_TOKEN> per our disclosure rules
- Hash: sha256:3f5b9a... (stored in evidence bucket)

Attachment: access_logs_20260902.csv (CSV, 2.1MB)

If you want a signed S3 manifest, tell me the email to deliver to and I will produce one (can take ~2 hours).

-Monica
Monica Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: access_logs_20260902.csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@finoptics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual access event on Sep 2 — IRP and walkthrough invite

Alex — attaching our IRP excerpt and a short recording invite. Quick context for your auditors: the event was classified as "access anomaly (non-customer data)" after initial triage. Root cause: automated token refresh that retried and triggered elevated logging due to a config change in a staging job.

Attachments included:
- irp_redwood_v3.4.pdf (IRP, formal version)
- invite.ics (walkthrough — 30 min)

Proposed time for walkthrough: Tue Sep 15, 10:00–10:30 PT. Ben will run a short slide deck and demo the log filtering criteria.

If that slot doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll do a recording and upload the postmortem draft.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: irp_redwood_v3.4.pdf, invite.ics)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@finoptics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Postmortem and final evidence bundle — Sep 2 staging access anomaly

Alex — thanks for taking the walkthrough. As promised, attaching the finalized postmortem and the signed evidence manifest. TL;DR: transient config regression caused repetitious token refresh attempts by an internal CI job, which generated high-volume authenticated requests to staging. No production data impacted.

Included in the bundle:
- postmortem_finoptics_access_anomaly_20260914.pdf (final postmortem with timeline, impact, remediation, and follow-ups)
- access_logs_20260902.csv (same CSV, now with manifest)
- evidence_manifest_signed.txt (S3 path + sha256 hashes)

Next steps we agreed on the call:
- Redwood will add a cadence to validate token expiry handling in CI (owner: infra team)
- FinOptics to confirm closure with auditors after they ingest the bundle

If you need any more artifacts (raw VM audit trails, kernel debug traces), say the word and we'll route through legal process.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: postmortem_finoptics_access_anomaly_20260914.pdf, evidence_manifest_signed.txt)
